techParks.name: Global Village Tech Park
techParks.locality: Pattanagere / Mylasandra, Rajarajeshwari Nagar - Kengeri, off Mysore Road (behind RV College of Engineering)
techParks.developer: Tanglin Developments (Coffee Day Group); owned since 2019 by Blackstone (80%) and Sattva Group (20%)
techParks.description: A 120-acre IT/ITES SEZ-plus-non-SEZ campus off Mysore Road beside Pattanagere metro station, built from 2005 by Cafe Coffee Day's realty arm Tanglin Developments and sold in September 2019 for about Rs 2,700 crore to a Blackstone (80%) / Salarpuria Sattva (20%) consortium, which renamed it Sattva Global City. Wikipedia and the sale reports give ~3.3 million sq ft built up across Towers A-F, Mindtree's Phases 1-5, the DRC and Ivega buildings and production blocks PB2-PB4 (the 'Texas Block' recalls an earlier Texas Instruments tenancy); Sattva's own page quotes 78.3 acres, 12.1 M sq ft leasable and 81.2% committed occupancy as of March 2025, figures that do not reconcile with the others and are flagged rather than adopted. OSM maps it as 'Sattva Global City'.

techParks.name: Bidadi Industrial Area
techParks.locality: Bidadi, Ramanagara (Bengaluru South district), Bengaluru-Mysuru highway
techParks.description: A roughly 1,500-acre KIADB manufacturing estate about 30 km south-west of Bengaluru on the Mysuru highway, anchored since 1997-98 by Toyota Kirloskar Motor and its group companies, which hold about 60% of the land and most of its exports; the Bidadi Industries Association counted 114-140 member units in 2016, mostly auto-component and food manufacturers, with Bosch, Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages and Britannia the other large names. A third Toyota plant was approved in 2024. OSM maps the core estate polygon; Coca-Cola's plant sits in the Phase 2 extension to the north near Hejjala.

techParks.name: Kumbalgodu Industrial Area
techParks.locality: Kumbalgodu, Mysore Road, between Kengeri and Bidadi
techParks.description: A small industrial estate on the Bengaluru-Mysuru road at Kumbalgodu, west of Kengeri, mapped in OSM as 'Kumbalagodu Industrial Area'. No notable MNC, mid-size or startup tenant could be substantiated for it in this pass (no company page, press report or OSM office POI inside the polygon), so it is recorded for its footprint only.

coverageNotes: VERIFIED: Global Village Tech Park (Sattva Global City) with primary-source tenants Mphasis (own contact page: SEZ campus, Tower E, Tower F), Sonata Software (own page: Tower A HQ, Tower F, DRC Building), Textron India (own page: Block B/Tower 2 registered office), Torry Harris (own page: Tower E 6th floor), Sagility (own page: Tower F 9th floor), LTIMindtree (own global-presence list + OSM Phase 1/2/3/5 POIs); broker-listing (cityinfoservices, one secondary source, so medium) tenants NTT DATA (Towers A, E), Tietoevry/Evry India (Tower E), Northern Trust (DRC Building), Wipfli India (Tower B), Magnasoft (Tower A), ZIV Automation (DRC), HGS (Tower A, low). Bidadi: Toyota Kirloskar Motor (Wikipedia + OSM polygon + area guide), TKAP (area guide), Bosch (bosch.in location page), HCCB (hccb.in lists Bidadi + OSM Coca-Cola polygon), Britannia (area guide + Wikipedia Bidadi). BHEL EDN from the OSM polygon on Mysore Road plus Wikipedia; Kennametal from the OSM Tumkur Road polygon (it is NOT on Mysore Road). COULD NOT CONFIRM / LEFT OUT: Accenture at Global Village - the 2019 sale article does not name it and no current tower listing or Accenture page does, so omitted (its Bengaluru sites are Pritech Park, Whitefield, IBC Knowledge Park, other lenses). Texas Instruments - the 'Texas Block (PB3)' name points to a past TI tenancy but the block's current tenant is listed as GlobalEdge, TI's campus is Bagmane Tech Park and the location of its new 550,000 sq ft R&D centre (opened Feb 2026) was not stated in any fetched report; omitted. Capgemini - Wikipedia-only lead, omitted. Wipro, Infosys, Tech Mahindra, L&T - no Mysore Road / Kengeri / Bidadi office found (Infosys and Wipro's Mysuru campuses are outside the bbox). Honda - no Bidadi plant; only the HMSI South Regional Office in Rajajinagar (OSM) is recorded. Wipro Infrastructure Engineering, Hitachi Energy/ABB - nothing found on this belt. GlobalEdge Software (listed as tenant of PB3/PB4) omitted because its domain is now parked for sale, so current status is unknown. Toyota Industries Engine India is at Jigani per its own site, not Bidadi, and had no coordinates, so omitted; Toyota Boshoku, Denso Kirloskar, Toyota Tsusho Techno Park at Bidadi could not be verified (company pages 403/404). Hino (OSM industrial polygon at Bidadi) omitted because Hino Motors Sales India's own location page lists no Karnataka site; Trinity Beverages (OSM polygon beside Coca-Cola) and Paramount Nutritions omitted as unverified/small. An OSM 'Rexroth' building in RR Nagar near the park could not be tied to Bosch Rexroth India (its site shows no addresses). NICE Ltd HQ and Texport Garments (OSM-only, RR Nagar/Kengeri) omitted. Composite Technology Park (RV-TIFAC, Kengeri) omitted as a research park with no verifiable corporate tenants. Kumbalgodu Industrial Area is recorded with no tenants. Offices named on primary pages but dropped for lack of coordinates: Mphasis Pritech Park, Torry Harris Millers Road and RMZ Ecoworld 4C, Sagility Surya Wave (Electronic City Ph 2). METHOD NOTES: the shared WebSearch budget was exhausted after the first batch, so verification relied on direct fetches of company, Wikipedia and broker pages plus the offline OSM extracts; several official pages were unreachable (northerntrust.com 503, wipfli.com 429, bhel.com 503, britannia.co.in 404, newindianexpress blocked, kennametal.com empty), which is why those entries sit at medium. All Global Village offices without their own OSM footprint use the park centroid (medium by rule); Phase 1-3/5 and Tower F use OSM building POIs. Park size is given as 3.3 M sq ft (Wikipedia/sale reports); Sattva's own 78.3-acre / 12.1 M sq ft figures conflict and are noted in the park description. Bidadi lies in Ramanagara (Bengaluru South) district but inside the metro bbox.
